create_marketplace_component: create a MarketPlace component with agents, goods, and a clearing house market type
build_good_order_dataclasses: build Good and Order dataclasses to define market goods and buy or sell orders
clear_auction_orders: clear auction orders by matching bids and asks and settling trades at midpoint prices
resolve_market_actions: resolve agent actions by parsing JSON orders and executing market clearing for all goods
serialize_marketplace_state: serialize and restore the full marketplace state including agents, orderbooks, and trade history
